$comment: Free abilities only. This public copy lists the abilities of the free plugin: the Pro abilities are removed for the public repository by scripts/wp-repo-sync.py (zinn_dotorg_free_abilities()). The full registry, Pro included, is GENERATED by wp/tests/wp-integration/mcp_abilities.sh from a running site; do not edit this copy.

mcp.auth: a WordPress application password (HTTP) or --user (WP-CLI); the user needs the capability each ability names
mcp.switch: Settings: Allow AI agents (MCP), on by default

rest.run: /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/abilities/<name>/run  (GET with ?input= for read-only abilities, POST {"input": {...}} otherwise)

abilities.name: pbs/add-local-font
abilities.label: Self-host a font
abilities.description: Downloads a Google font family (family, weights, italic) and serves it from this site.

abilities.name: pbs/add-section
abilities.label: Add a section to a page
abilities.description: Adds a ready-made section to a page: at the start, at the end, or after the section at a given position.

section.description: The name of a section in this site's section library.

after.description: With position "after": the 0-based position of the section to insert after.

abilities.name: pbs/ai-generate-section
abilities.label: Generate a section with AI
abilities.description: Turns a one-sentence description into a ready-designed section (real, editable blocks in the site's brand style) with text written for it. Returns the block markup, and adds it to the start or end of a page when a post_id is given (a revision keeps what was there before).
abilities.capability: edit_posts; edit_post to add it to a page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-save-seo-meta
abilities.label: Save an SEO title and description
abilities.description: Saves a meta title and description into the SEO plugin the site uses (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or All in One SEO) and says which ones were written.

abilities.name: pbs/ai-suggest-seo-meta
abilities.label: Suggest an SEO title and description with AI
abilities.description: Reads a page and suggests a meta title (up to 60 characters) and meta description (up to 155), optionally around a focus keyword. Nothing is saved.
abilities.capability: edit_post on the page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-undo
abilities.label: Undo an AI change
abilities.description: Puts a page back the way it was before an AI change, from the undo_revision that change returned.

abilities.name: pbs/ai-write-alt-text
abilities.label: Write image alt text with AI
abilities.description: Looks at images and saves alt text for them: one image (attachment_id), or every image on a page that has none (post_id). At most 20 images per call; the answer says how many remain.
abilities.capability: upload_files and edit_post on the image or page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-write-text
abilities.label: Write or rewrite text with AI
abilities.description: Writes new text, or improves, shortens, expands, changes the tone of or fixes the grammar of a piece of text, with the site's own AI provider. Returns the new text; nothing on the site is changed.
abilities.capability: edit_posts (edit_post when post_id is given); the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/apply-kit
abilities.label: Import a website kit
abilities.description: Imports a website kit's pages (all of them, or the ones named), optionally publishing them, setting the home page and adding them to a menu. Importing again updates the same pages.
abilities.capability: edit_pages and publish_pages; manage_options to set the home page; edit_theme_options to create a menu

abilities.name: pbs/build-landing-page
abilities.label: Build a landing page
abilities.description: A guided workflow: the agent picks sections that fit your business, builds the page as a draft and writes its text.

business.description: The business, its offer and its audience.

abilities.name: pbs/connect-support
abilities.label: Connect to support
abilities.description: Connects this site to Zinn Digital® support (name, email, consent).

abilities.name: pbs/convert-post
abilities.label: Convert one legacy page
abilities.description: Converts one 5.x page to blocks (backed up first).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/create-page
abilities.label: Create a page
abilities.description: Creates a page from library sections and/or block content. A new page is a draft unless another status is asked for.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; publish_pages to publish or make private

sections.description: Names of sections in this site's section library, in page order. They come before any content given.

content.description: Block markup (the format the block editor saves).

abilities.name: pbs/delete-icon
abilities.label: Delete an uploaded icon
abilities.description: Removes an uploaded icon; blocks that used it keep their own copy.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-page
abilities.label: Move a page to the trash
abilities.description: Moves a page to the trash. It can be restored from Pages, Trash for 30 days.

abilities.name: pbs/disconnect-support
abilities.label: Disconnect from support
abilities.description: Disconnects this site from support.

abilities.name: pbs/duplicate-page
abilities.label: Duplicate a page
abilities.description: Copies a page (its title, content and template) into a new draft.
abilities.capability: edit_post on the page and edit_pages

abilities.name: pbs/export-designs
abilities.label: Export designs and settings
abilities.description: Exports the chosen templates and patterns (ids) and, optionally, settings as one package for another site.

abilities.name: pbs/get-block
abilities.label: Describe a builder block
abilities.description: Returns one block's settings (attributes with their types, choices and defaults), what it supports, which blocks it may contain, and a ready-to-use example in block markup.

abilities.name: pbs/get-breakpoints
abilities.label: Read the responsive breakpoints
abilities.description: Returns the tablet and mobile widths (and custom breakpoints in Pro) the responsive controls use.

abilities.name: pbs/get-design-globals
abilities.label: Read the site design
abilities.description: Returns the site-wide colours and fonts (heading and body) every block uses, as the Site design screen shows them.

abilities.name: pbs/get-diagnostics
abilities.label: Read the site diagnostics
abilities.description: Returns the diagnostics a support ticket would carry: versions, active plugins, limits and recent errors.

abilities.name: pbs/get-licence
abilities.label: Read the licence
abilities.description: Returns this site's Page Builder Sandwich plan, licence state, renewal date and what the plan includes.

abilities.name: pbs/get-migration
abilities.label: Read the legacy migration
abilities.description: Returns the 5.x content conversion's progress and report.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/get-page
abilities.label: Read a page
abilities.description: Returns a page's title, status, links and block content, and the sections (top-level blocks) it is made of.

abilities.name: pbs/get-settings
abilities.label: Read the plugin settings
abilities.description: Returns the front-end class prefix, the beta-updates state and whether AI agents (MCP) are allowed.

abilities.name: pbs/get-support-connection
abilities.label: Read the support connection
abilities.description: Says whether this site is connected to Zinn Digital® support, and as whom.

abilities.name: pbs/import-designs
abilities.label: Import designs and settings
abilities.description: Imports a Page Builder Sandwich design package (dryRun first to see what would change; mode: skip or replace; media; settings).

abilities.name: pbs/list-blocks
abilities.label: List the builder blocks
abilities.description: Lists every Page Builder Sandwich block this site can use (Pro blocks too when Pro is active): name, title, category and description.

abilities.name: pbs/list-extensions
abilities.label: List the builder's add-on extensions
abilities.description: Lists what other plugins have added to Page Builder Sandwich through its developer API: blocks, dynamic data sources, display conditions and form actions, each with its name, label and plugin.

abilities.name: pbs/list-forms
abilities.label: List forms
abilities.description: Lists the forms built with the Form block and the form plugins it can embed.

abilities.name: pbs/list-kits
abilities.label: List website kits
abilities.description: Lists the website kits (a set of ready-made pages for one kind of business) this site can import.

abilities.name: pbs/list-local-fonts
abilities.label: List self-hosted fonts
abilities.description: Lists the Google fonts this site hosts itself (downloaded once, served from the site, no request to Google).

abilities.name: pbs/list-pages
abilities.label: List pages
abilities.description: Lists the pages you can edit, newest first, with an optional search.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; only pages the user can edit are listed

search.description: Words to search for in the title and content.

abilities.name: pbs/list-sections
abilities.label: List sections
abilities.description: Lists the ready-made sections (hero, features, FAQ, testimonials, call to action and more) that can be added to a page.

search.description: Words to match in a section's name or keywords.

abilities.name: pbs/list-transferable
abilities.label: List what can be exported
abilities.description: Lists the templates, patterns and settings that can be exported to another site.

abilities.name: pbs/list-uploaded-icons
abilities.label: List uploaded icons
abilities.description: Lists the SVG icons uploaded to the icon library, newest first.

abilities.name: pbs/move-section
abilities.label: Move a section
abilities.description: Moves a section of a page from one position to another (0-based, in the order the page lists them).

abilities.name: pbs/open-support-ticket
abilities.label: Open a support ticket
abilities.description: Files a support ticket (subject, message, kind, email), with this site's diagnostics when the administrator agreed. It never creates a login or sends one.

kind.description: The kind of request; help when omitted.

email.description: Reply address; the connected support email when omitted.

diagnostics.description: True attaches this site's diagnostics (needs the administrator's consent).

abilities.name: pbs/record-support-consent
abilities.label: Consent to support diagnostics
abilities.description: Records the administrator's consent to send diagnostics with support tickets.

consent.description: True records the administrator's consent to send diagnostics with support tickets.

abilities.name: pbs/remove-block
abilities.label: Remove a block from a page
abilities.description: Removes one block (a whole section, or a block inside one) from a page, found by its path. The page's previous version stays in its revisions.

path.description: Where the block is: its position among the page's sections, then among that block's inner blocks, and so on (0-based), in the order the page lists them.

abilities.name: pbs/remove-local-font
abilities.label: Remove a self-hosted font
abilities.description: Deletes a self-hosted font family's files.

abilities.name: pbs/start-migration
abilities.label: Convert legacy content
abilities.description: Starts (or restarts) converting every 5.x page to blocks; each post is backed up first.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/start-trial
abilities.label: Start the free Pro trial
abilities.description: Starts the 14-day Page Builder Sandwich Pro trial for this site (no payment needed).

abilities.name: pbs/undo-convert-post
abilities.label: Undo one conversion
abilities.description: Restores one converted page from its backup.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/undo-migration
abilities.label: Undo the legacy migration
abilities.description: Restores every converted post from its backup.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/update-block
abilities.label: Change one block's settings
abilities.description: Changes the settings (attributes) of one block inside a page, found by its path; attributes you send are merged over the current ones. Works on blocks the site renders from their settings; a block whose HTML is saved in the page is changed by replacing the page's markup.

path.description: Where the block is: its position among the page's sections, then among that block's inner blocks, and so on (0-based), in the order the page lists them.

abilities.name: pbs/update-breakpoints
abilities.label: Change the responsive breakpoints
abilities.description: Changes the tablet and mobile widths in pixels; with Pro, custom extra breakpoints.

abilities.name: pbs/update-design-globals
abilities.label: Change the site design
abilities.description: Changes the site-wide colours (colors), fonts (fonts, headingFont, bodyFont). Every page picks the change up; the theme's theme.json is kept in sync.

abilities.name: pbs/update-page
abilities.label: Update a page
abilities.description: Changes a page's title, status or block content. Content you send replaces the page's content.
abilities.capability: edit_post on that page; publish_pages to publish or make private

sections.description: Names of sections in this site's section library, in page order. They come before any content given.

content.description: Block markup (the format the block editor saves).

abilities.name: pbs/update-settings
abilities.label: Change the plugin settings
abilities.description: Changes the front-end class prefix (1 to 8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter) and/or turns AI agents (MCP) on or off (mcp: false removes every ability and the MCP endpoint).

abilities.name: pbs/upload-icon
abilities.label: Upload an icon
abilities.description: Adds an SVG icon (name, svg markup) to the icon library; the SVG is sanitised first.
